answer: Plant each identity in a garden whose soil is salted with the head's own prior failures: a clone that starts fresh inherits sterile ground, so it must first grow a cover crop of cheap but genuine attestations before any reward is paid out. A sparrow is released each epoch to forage randomly through the beds and report what it finds, so a farm cannot predict which rows will be inspected. Every harvest is then written as a sonnet with fixed metre: only histories that scan cleanly under the metre count, and padded or padded-out records fail the scansion and are cut.
